data.one_liner: Dart code builder generating typed classes from GraphQL documents and SDL
data.what_it_does: Generates Dart code classes from GraphQL documents (.graphql) and GraphQL Schema Definition Language (SDL). It produces structured AST and source code definitions for variables, data classes, and serializers using code_builder. It primarily serves as the low-level foundation for build packages such as package:gql_build.
use_when: Building custom code-generation tools or custom builders for GraphQL documents and SDL in Dart
Developing higher-level GraphQL tools or integrating with package:gql_build
avoid_when: Needing an end-user code generation runner (use higher-level tools like package:gql_build instead)
Not working with GraphQL schemas or ASTs
strengths: Integrates directly with code_builder and analyzer for fine-grained code generation
Supports advanced GraphQL features like fragment spreads, inline fragments, and tristate values (null vs absent)
weaknesses: The API is explicitly unstable and intended primarily for internal use by package:gql_build
Documentation and examples are minimal in the package README
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up code generation infrastructure or integrating via build_runner and package:gql_build.
